stem: Symptoms remain limited to one propagation batch. Which response best protects clean stock while evidence is reviewed?
choices: Mix the batch with healthy plants to see whether symptoms spread.
Maintain the defined quarantine/movement controls and trace source/material contacts.
Move suspect plants between rooms for comparison.
Relax sanitation because the issue is localized.
rationale: Maintain the defined quarantine/movement controls and trace source/material contacts.
